verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile lets users assign issues to Copilot and manage/track 'Agent Tasks' that run autonomously in the cloud, which is a real background-automation capability documented in first-party docs. However, all evidence is vendor-sourced with no independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific feature, and no detail on scheduling, triggers, or configuring automation rules beyond starting/monitoring tasks. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of Agent Tasks reliability, detail on setting recurring/triggered automations rather than one-off task assignment.
